name: Streak
summary: CRM built directly inside Gmail: manage pipelines, leads and deals from your inbox with email tracking, mail merge and shared views — ideal for teams that live in Google Workspace.
best_for: solo founders and small Gmail-native teams whose pipeline genuinely lives in email threads and who want zero context-switching
skip_if: your team needs shared process outside the inbox (a standalone CRM scales better), or you're price-sensitive — the Gmail convenience now costs full CRM money
honest_knock: The pitch — CRM living inside Gmail — is also the ceiling: everything happens in the inbox, which power users love and growing teams outgrow (reporting, permissions, cross-team process). And note the trajectory: the free tier is gone and per-seat prices sit at real-CRM levels now, so the 'lightweight Gmail add-on' framing no longer matches the invoice. If the inbox is truly where your deals live, few tools feel this natural.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-22 against the vendor's own pricing page; every plan figure identical to the 31 Aug 2026 reading) (2026) Pro $49/user/mo annual or $59 monthly; Pro+ $69 annual or $89 monthly; Enterprise $129 annual or $159 monthly - a flat 20% annual discount. CORRECTION 22 Sep 2026: Enterprise is NOT annual-only and carries no published seat minimum. The FAQ 'Can I pay monthly instead of annually?' answers yes and prices all three plans monthly, Enterprise at $159; the words minimum, ten seats and 10+ do not occur on the page. Everyone on a team must be on the same plan (FAQ: 'Can team members be on different Streak plans? No'), and there is no view-only or read-only seat price, so every user on the team is billed a full seat. AI credits are a second meter: 20 per user per month on Pro, 150 on Pro+, 500 on Enterprise, pooled across the team, spent only on successful operations and expiring each period with no roll-over. Credit costs published 22 Sep 2026: deal summary 1, deal Q&A 1, autofill from the deal timeline 1, autofill with web research 2, meeting agenda 1, automated AI actions 1 credit per 10 runs. Top-ups, purchasable by team admins only and billed as a separate recurring add-on on your billing cycle: 1,000 credits $100/mo, 2,500 $200/mo, 10,000 $500/mo, 25,000 $1,000/mo - $0.10 down to $0.04 a credit. The free CRM tier was eliminated in 2024-25, but the free email tools remain - email and link tracking, snippets, Streak Share, a thread splitter, and mail merge at 50/day against 1,500*/day on all three paid plans; the free plan has no CRM pipelines. Pro+ has a 14-day free trial that includes 1,000 AI credits.
